title: Ingest year-checkpoint receipt (per adapter)
description: Committed per-adapter ingest checkpoint at datasets/_ops/ingest-state/<adapter_slug>.json (TODO/20260618-backend-ingest-pipeline-rip-replace-plan.md D4 + Row 2). Records, per year, the sha256 of the RAW fetched upstream payload, whether that year completed Fetch->Enrich->Publish, and the staleness clock last_checked. A re-run SKIPS a year iff its stored raw_sha256 equals the hash of the freshly fetched payload AND completed is true; a changed hash on an already-completed old year RE-OPENS it (a revised estimate); a failed run resumes from the last completed year. A skip STILL advances last_checked so staleness is never hidden. last_checked is the allowed control-plane wall-clock carve-out (CLAUDE.md datetime.now() anti-pattern + the manifest.json / _ops control-plane carve-out): it is operator telemetry, not observation provenance. Operator-axis state, not citizen-facing, not inventoried.

x-changelog.description: Initial per-adapter ingest year-checkpoint schema (Row 2 / D4). Per-year raw-payload sha256 + completed flag + last_checked staleness clock + optional provisional/revised estimate_status; spec_version stored so the delta engine can re-open all years on a spec bump (Row 5).

adapter_slug.description: The registered adapter slug this checkpoint belongs to. MUST equal the filename stem (enforced by tier_b_ingest_state_receipt).

spec_version.description: The SourceSpec.spec_version this checkpoint was built under. A spec_version bump re-opens all years (the delta engine re-emits, Row 5); stored here so the orchestrator can detect the bump. Row 2 stores it; the skip predicate itself is raw-hash-only.

years.description: One entry per year touched by an ingest run. Year-unique within a receipt (enforced by tier_b_ingest_state_receipt).

year.description: Calendar year of the upstream payload slice. The checkpoint is addressed by year (the natural cache unit of every single-series source).

raw_sha256.description: sha256 hexdigest of the RAW fetched upstream payload for this year (hash the bytes BEFORE any parse/canonicalisation). Equality with a freshly fetched payload's hash is the skip predicate; a changed hash re-opens the year.

completed.description: True iff this year cleared Fetch->Enrich->Publish. A failed mid-run leaves it false so --resume re-processes it; a skip requires completed=true.

last_checked.description: Control-plane ISO-8601 UTC 'Z' timestamp (the allowed datetime.now() carve-out for _ops control-plane state). Advanced on EVERY check including a skip, so staleness against update_period_days is never hidden.

estimate_status.description: Optional. Ties the provisional-vs-revised India-discontinuity gate to the checkpoint re-open: a 'provisional' year flips to 'revised' when the publisher restates it (its raw hash changes).
